{{Top|leg}}
'''Lev Xestra''' was an accomplished [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] stunt racer, and one of only three beings to beat the [[Raptor Run]] time limit and claim the prize of one thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a free drink&mdash;the other two prize-winners being [[Blizz Pinnix]] and a punk kid from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
